Examen des débris de la chaudière n° 2.\:
Examination of the debris of boiler no. 2.

The rupture started in the boiler body, at the location of the safety valve — which was missing. Pressure rose with no relief device and no gauge to warn of it. No trace of explosives, no mechanical sabotage.

Conclusion: failure due to the prolonged absence of safety parts. A shutdown would have been enough to prevent it.

La chaudière n° 2 a explosé par défailla: Boiler no. 2 exploded through failure: the safety valve, requested since September, was never delivered, and a safety shutdown was refused three days earlier. The requisitions were approved — and diverted to the parallel market — by Captain L. ORLIK's office, which also signs the incident report concluding sabotage to cover itself. The three "suspects" were chosen for their vulnerability: Mira SEDLAR (family already on file in 40921), Piotr VELA (born abroad), Jonas RUDA (dead, and therefore silent). There is no saboteur.

Read the maintenance register before the Militia report. Ask yourself who was approving the requisitions for that boiler, and why the same man signs the report that speaks of sabotage. Then choose, knowing what you are choosing. I have said nothing.

R. MAZUR
